question: The book ‘Gitanjali’ is authored by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rabindranath Tagore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gitanjali** is a collection of poems by **Rabindranath Tagore**, a Bengali poet.
 
• Tagore was awarded the **Nobel Prize in Literature, **largely for Song Offerings, his English translation.
 
• It is part of the **UNESCO Representative Works Collection**. On August 14, 1910, the original Bengali collection of 156/157 poems was published.
 
• Rabindranath Tagore was a poet, novelist, playwright, composer, philosopher, social reformer, and painter from Bengal.
 
• With Contextual Modernism in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, he altered Bengali literature and music, as well as Indian art.
 
• He was the **first non-European** and the **first lyricist **to win the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1913, for his "profoundly sensitive, fresh, and lovely" poetry of Gitanjali. The Royal Asiatic Society elected him as a fellow.
 
• Tagore was dubbed "the Bard of Bengal" and went by the moniker** Gurudev, Kobiguru, and Biswakobi**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Devaki Nandan Khatri** was an Indian novelist who lived in Varanasi and published Chandrakanta, a historical fiction fantasy novel.
 
• **Harivansh Rai Bachchan** was an early twentieth-century Hindi poet and writer associated with the Nayi Kavita literary movement.
 
• **Ganga Da**s was a respected Udasi saint and a Hindi poet from Uttar Pradesh's Hapur area.
